summary_rationale: Coforge is a high-execution, domain-led mid-tier Indian IT and digital engineering compounder that has grown revenue from ₹2,372 Cr (FY15) to ₹16,403 Cr (FY26) and ₹20,380 Cr TTM (Sep 2026) while maintaining 23.5% ROCE and 21.4% ROE. Under CEO Sudhir Singh (since May 2017), it has demonstrated repeatable M&A integration across Incessant, WHISHWORKS, SLK Global, and Cigniti (lifting Cigniti EBITDA margin from ~11% to ~19%), and expanded its 12-month executable order book to $2.38B in Q2 FY27 (+45% YoY) with 10.4% LTM attrition and 82.4% utilization. However, kpi_health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because the $2.35B Encora acquisition (closed May 1, 2026) transformed the balance sheet—lifting borrowings from ₹728 Cr (Mar 2026) to ₹6,026 Cr (Sep 2026) and fixed/intangible assets from ₹6,760 Cr to ₹23,592 Cr alongside ~20% equity dilution—while FY26 debtor days stretched to 88 and CFO/EBITDA moderated to 76%.
